question: 论文中的语言模型和人分别承担什么设计工作？

gold_quotes.quote: In the first high-level phase, the computer and the human collaborate on a conceptual level, discussing ideas and outlining the specifications for the robot design while in the second phase the physical implementation of the design specifications takes place.
Although LLMs can currently not generate entire CAD models, test code, or automatically fabricate the robot
The human is therefore relegated to the technician role, polishing the code proposed by the LLM, finalizing the CAD, and fabricating the robot.
